shortDescription: Manages load balancer pools on the cloudscale.ch IaaS service

options.name: algorithm
options.description: The algorithm according to which the incoming traffic is distributed between the pool members. See the [API documentation](https://www.cloudscale.ch/en/api/v1#pool-algorithms) for supported distribution algorithms.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for calls to the cloudscale.ch API. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TIMEOUT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: cloudscale.ch API token. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: api_url
options.description: cloudscale.ch API URL. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_URL) environment variable.

options.name: load_balancer
options.description: UUID of the load balancer for this pool.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the load balancer pool.

options.name: protocol
options.description: The protocol used for traffic between the load balancer and the pool members. See the [API documentation](https://www.cloudscale.ch/en/api/v1#pool-protocols) for supported protocols.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the load balancer pool.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags assosiated with the load balancer. Set this to C({}) to clear any tags.

options.name: uuid
options.description: UUID of the load balancer pool. Either I(name) or I(uuid) are required.
